description: In Sardasht survivors, photophobia and ocular surface discomfort were the most significant symptoms, with bulbar conjunctival and limbal changes the predominant findings. Sunlight becomes a scheduling constraint on a life.
energy_note: Planning your day around the brightness of it.

aspect: Retinal involvement was only assessed recently
description: Electrophysiological assessment of 40 severely intoxicated Iranian veterans addressed the retina, which had not been examined despite well-documented anterior-segment damage - meaning survivors were assessed for decades with half the eye unexamined.
energy_note: Thirty years of looking at the wrong part of the eye.

description: Olfactory memory has direct access to limbic structures and no linguistic intermediary. Diesel, burning plastic, wet concrete, a particular disinfectant - each reproduces the state in full, in a supermarket, with no warning.
energy_note: Thirty years erased by a smell in aisle four.

aspect: Nobody screens for it and nobody treats it
description: There is no standard olfactory trigger assessment in trauma care, so the most reliable reactivator of the memory is the one never addressed in the treatment plan.
energy_note: The main trigger, absent from every protocol.
